description: Artificial-streaming (streaming-integrity) reads. Pick ONE `view`: `flags` — Stream Radar early-warning flags, paginated (`filters`: status, severity, dsp, isrc, release_id, detected_from/detected_to). Stream Radar is an optional add-on; without it the API returns a 403, surfaced verbatim. `flag_detail` — one flag by `flag_id`. `records` — reported artificial-streaming records, cursor-paginated; the detail behind any artificial-streaming fee (`filters`: dsp, start_date/end_date, release_id, isrc). `fee_breakdown` — per-release fee breakdown for one `period` (YYYY-MM). response_format:'detailed' returns the verbatim API response.

filters.description: Filter names → values, passed through verbatim.
